Package com.smu.mtc.runner

Class MTC_BuildRunner

java.lang.Object
com.smu.mtc.runner.MTC_BuildRunner
public final class MTC_BuildRunner extends Object
One-shot entry point meant to be invoked periodically by an external scheduler (systemd timer / cron), once per Utils.DURATION window. Each invocation:
  1. loads (or, on the very first run ever, generates and persists) the admin ML-DSA signing key;
  2. in a single database transaction, locks and consumes a batch of ADD rows from the pending_certs queue table, assigns each a certInd based on the tree's current leaf count, builds one Merkle tree round via MTC_Service_AppendOnly.build(java.util.ArrayList<com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.MTC_Cert_Record>, long), and marks those rows processed;
  3. exits 0 on success, non-zero on failure — leaving the transaction rolled back so the next scheduled run retries/catches up (see MTC_Service_AppendOnly.build(java.util.ArrayList<com.smu.mtc.mtcbean.MTC_Cert_Record>, long)'s round catch-up logic).

Configuration is read entirely from environment variables (see main(java.lang.String[])), so the same jar can be deployed unchanged across environments. See deploy/mtc.env.example and the systemd unit files under deploy/systemd/.

Not for interactive/query use: there is deliberately no method here for serving getMemberProof/validate requests; this process only ever advances the tree.

  • Method Details

    • main

      public static void main(String[] args)
      Process entry point. Reads configuration from environment variables:
      • MTC_DB_URL (required) — e.g. jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/pfs?useSSL=false&serverTimezone=UTC
      • MTC_DB_USER, MTC_DB_PASSWORD (required)
      • MTC_DB_POOL_SIZE (optional, default 3)
      • MTC_ADMIN_SK_PATH, MTC_ADMIN_PK_PATH (required)
      • MTC_QUEUE_BATCH_SIZE (optional, default 500)
      Parameters:
      args - unused.

    • runOnce

      public static int runOnce(String jdbcUrl, String dbUser, String dbPassword, int dbPoolSize, Path adminSkPath, Path adminPkPath, int queueBatchSize) throws Exception
      Runs one full build round against the given MySQL database. Package-visible entry point used both by main(java.lang.String[]) and by tests, so it can be exercised without an environment-variable/process boundary.
      Parameters:
      jdbcUrl - JDBC connection string, e.g. jdbc:mysql://127.0.0.1:3306/pfs?useSSL=false&serverTimezone=UTC.
      dbUser - database username.
      dbPassword - database password.
      dbPoolSize - HikariCP max pool size (this is a one-shot batch job, not a server; a small pool is normally enough).
      adminSkPath - path to the persisted admin private key PEM.
      adminPkPath - path to the persisted admin public key PEM.
      queueBatchSize - max number of pending_certs rows to consume in one round.
      Returns:
      the number of pending certificates processed in this round.
      Throws:
      Exception - if key setup, the database transaction, or the Merkle build fails; the caller should treat this as "this round did not happen" (transaction is rolled back) and retry on the next scheduled invocation.
